text:
Per our policy, if there's no reply within 3 days of the out-of-stock email, the item is automatically refunded. Since it's been 4 days, your fern should have been refunded already, so please check your original payment method and your order status in "My Orders."

I don't have policy details on how long the refund takes to appear after an automatic refund, so I can't give you a timeframe for that. If you don't see the refund or the order still shows the fern as pending, I can escalate this to a Support Lead. If you share your order number (it looks like LF-123456), I can include it in the escalation.
